newsitem.title: UK: Burmah continues slide after downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Burmah continues slide after downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Burmah Castrol Plc fell 16-1/2 pence to 1,016, still under pressure after brokers recently trimmed their results forecasts, market makers said.
"Their is still some stock in the market and there simply aren't many buyers around after the downgrades," said one market maker.

Cazenove on Monday was the latest broker cutting its profit estimates, giving Burmah another push on a downward slide begun drop on January 9 when HSBC James Capel was said to have trimmed its forecasts. Burmah closed at 1,109 pence on January 8.
